purpose: Canonical runtime source registry and display configuration for MathBridge evidence assembly.
merge_rules: Merge source extensions by exact source_id.
Deduplicate duplicate source IDs; keep the record with more complete metadata without lowering authority/status information.
Source display profiles do not change source authority or evidence status.
A source may support more than one claim type, but only claim types explicitly allowed by card_evidence_assembly_rules.json may be surfaced.
display_order: Current textbook evidence supporting exact sequence, if available.
Official teaching guidance supporting representation/method description.
language_rule: Source identity, evidence status and locator remain language-independent; labels/descriptions are localized.
